density_cloud.derived: Monte Carlo sampling: accept point (x,y) with probability ∝ |ψ(x,y)|²

srtc.R: A 2D canvas with coordinate axes and a nucleus dot at the origin. Points are progressively sampled and plotted, accumulating into a density cloud. The cloud color is navy blue. Switching states clears the canvas and begins resampling. An equation updates to reflect the active wavefunction.
srtc.T: Clicking a segment button (1s / 2p / 3d) sets orbital_state, clears all existing sample points, and triggers a new Monte Carlo sampling run using the corresponding wavefunction's acceptance probability.
srtc.C: Each orbital state produces a distinct, characteristic spatial density pattern: 1s is spherically symmetric, 2p is a dumbbell shape with a nodal plane, and 3d forms a four-lobed clover pattern—matching theoretical quantum mechanics predictions.
